/*==========================================================
            MBA TRAVELS HERO
            PART 1 - FOUNDATION & SLIDER
==========================================================*/

/* Reset only inside hero */

.mba-hero,
.mba-hero *,
.mba-hero *::before,
.mba-hero *::after{
    box-sizing:border-box;
}

/*========================================
        HERO
========================================*/

.mba-hero{

    position:relative;

    width:100vw;
    max-width:100vw;

    margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw);
    margin-right:calc(50% - 50vw);

    height:100svh;
    min-height:720px;

    overflow:hidden;

    background:#071120;

    isolation:isolate;

}

/* Prevent Astra from restricting width */

.entry-content .mba-hero,
.site-content .mba-hero,
.ast-container .mba-hero,
.wp-block-group .mba-hero{

    width:100vw;
    max-width:100vw;

    margin-left:calc(50% - 50vw);
    margin-right:calc(50% - 50vw);

}

/*========================================
            SLIDER
========================================*/

.mba-slider{

    position:absolute;

    inset:0;

    width:100%;
    height:100%;

    z-index:1;

}

/*========================================
            SLIDE
========================================*/

.mba-slide{

    position:absolute;

    inset:0;

    opacity:0;

    visibility:hidden;

    transition:
    opacity 1.2s ease,
    visibility 1.2s ease;

}

.mba-slide.active{

    opacity:1;

    visibility:visible;

    z-index:2;

}

/*========================================
        IMAGE
========================================*/

.mba-slide img{

    display:block;

    width:100%;
    height:100%;

    object-fit:cover;
    object-position:center center;

    filter:brightness(.78) saturate(1.08);

    user-select:none;
    pointer-events:none;
    -webkit-user-drag:none;

}

/*========================================
        OVERLAY
========================================*/

.mba-overlay{

    position:absolute;

    inset:0;

    z-index:3;

    background:

    linear-gradient(

        90deg,

        rgba(7,17,32,.88) 0%,

        rgba(7,17,32,.65) 40%,

        rgba(7,17,32,.22) 100%

    );

}

/*========================================
        DARK TOP & BOTTOM
========================================*/

.mba-hero::before{

    content:"";

    position:absolute;

    inset:0;

    z-index:4;

    pointer-events:none;

    background:

    linear-gradient(

        180deg,

        rgba(0,0,0,.18),

        transparent 20%,

        transparent 70%,

        rgba(0,0,0,.28)

    );

}

/*========================================
        IMAGE ANIMATION
========================================*/

@keyframes mbaKenBurns{

    from{

        transform:scale(1);

    }

    to{

        transform:scale(1.10);

    }

}

.mba-slide.active img{

    animation:mbaKenBurns 9s linear forwards;

}

/*========================================
        IMAGE PERFORMANCE
========================================*/

.mba-slide img{

    backface-visibility:hidden;

    transform:translateZ(0);

    will-change:transform;

}

    left:-120%;

    top:0;

    height:100%;

    transform:skewX(-25deg);

.mba-primary-btn:hover::before{

.mba-location{

    position:absolute;

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded",function(){

const slides=document.querySelectorAll(".mba-slide");

const progress=document.querySelectorAll(".mba-progress span");

const hero=document.querySelector(".mba-hero");

let current=0;

let slider;

const delay=8000;


/*=====================================
        Show Slide
======================================*/

function showSlide(index){

slides.forEach(slide=>{

slide.classList.remove("active");

});

progress.forEach(dot=>{

dot.classList.remove("active");

});

slides[index].classList.add("active");

progress[index].classList.add("active");

current=index;

}


/*=====================================
        Next Slide
======================================*/

function nextSlide(){

let next=current+1;

if(next>=slides.length){

next=0;

}

showSlide(next);

}


/*=====================================
        Previous Slide
======================================*/

function previousSlide(){

let prev=current-1;

if(prev<0){

prev=slides.length-1;

}

showSlide(prev);

}


/*=====================================
        Auto Slider
======================================*/

function startSlider(){

slider=setInterval(function(){

nextSlide();

},delay);

}

function stopSlider(){

clearInterval(slider);

}


/*=====================================
      Vertical Progress Click
======================================*/

progress.forEach(function(item,index){

item.addEventListener("click",function(){

stopSlider();

showSlide(index);

startSlider();

});

});


/*=====================================
      Previous / Next Keys
======================================*/

document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){

if(e.key==="ArrowRight"){

stopSlider();

nextSlide();

startSlider();

}

if(e.key==="ArrowLeft"){

stopSlider();

previousSlide();

startSlider();

}

});


/*=====================================
       Pause on Hover
======================================*/

hero.addEventListener("mouseenter",stopSlider);

hero.addEventListener("mouseleave",startSlider);


/*=====================================
        Touch Swipe
======================================*/

let touchStart=0;

let touchEnd=0;

hero.addEventListener("touchstart",function(e){

touchStart=e.changedTouches[0].screenX;

});

hero.addEventListener("touchend",function(e){

touchEnd=e.changedTouches[0].screenX;

handleSwipe();

});

function handleSwipe(){

if(touchEnd<touchStart-60){

stopSlider();

nextSlide();

startSlider();

}

if(touchEnd>touchStart+60){

stopSlider();

previousSlide();

startSlider();

}

}


/*=====================================
      Page Visibility API
======================================*/

document.addEventListener("visibilitychange",function(){

if(document.hidden){

stopSlider();

}else{

startSlider();

}

});


/*=====================================
       Hero In View
======================================*/

const observer=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){

entries.forEach(function(entry){

if(entry.isIntersecting){

startSlider();

}else{

stopSlider();

}

});

});

observer.observe(hero);


/*=====================================
      Initial Slide
======================================*/

showSlide(0);

startSlider();

});

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

    // ==========================================
    // Scroll Reveal Animation
    // ==========================================

    const revealItems = document.querySelectorAll(".mba-reveal");

    if (revealItems.length) {

        const observer = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {

            entries.forEach(function (entry) {

                if (entry.isIntersecting) {

                    entry.target.classList.add("revealed");
                    observer.unobserve(entry.target);

                }

            });

        }, {
            threshold: 0.15,
            rootMargin: "0px 0px -80px 0px"
        });

        revealItems.forEach(function (item) {
            observer.observe(item);
        });

    }


    // ==========================================
    // FAQ Accordion
    // ==========================================

    const faqItems = document.querySelectorAll(".mba-faq-item");

    faqItems.forEach(function (item) {

        const question = item.querySelector(".mba-faq-question");
        const answer = item.querySelector(".mba-faq-answer");

        // Open default active FAQ
        if (item.classList.contains("active")) {

            answer.style.maxHeight = answer.scrollHeight + "px";

        } else {

            answer.style.maxHeight = "0px";

        }

        question.addEventListener("click", function () {

            const alreadyOpen = item.classList.contains("active");

            // Close all FAQs
            faqItems.forEach(function (faq) {

                faq.classList.remove("active");

                const faqAnswer = faq.querySelector(".mba-faq-answer");

                faqAnswer.style.maxHeight = "0px";

            });

            // If clicked FAQ was closed, open it
            if (!alreadyOpen) {

                item.classList.add("active");

                answer.style.maxHeight = answer.scrollHeight + "px";

            }

        });

    });

});
